opens.observation: Original black-and-white circuit: antenna at the upper tuning node, ground at the lower tuning node; left inductor and diagonally arrow-marked variable capacitor connect across these same nodes. Complete modern preview: labels L and C identify the left parallel tuning branches; C has a diagonal variability arrow. Diode labels the upper rectifier. The unlabelled right capacitor is in the detector/output section, and Headphones labels the two far-right earpieces. Both far-right earpieces, the entire lower return, ground and bottom label are visible. All relevant circuit connections match the original.
